Equipment / A-30

COMPACT CRAWLER / WALL INSPECTION

A-30

Swim in, roll over, crawl along the wall.

A 35 kg crawler inspection robot that swims, rolls onto a wall and crawls along it, for close inspection of tanks, pools, pipes and structure surfaces to 100 m.

Tasks to assess

  • Tasks that combine a camera with a contact or near-contact NDT probe
Read the application guide

Configuration checks

  • Confirm wall material, cleanliness and curvature for crawling and adhesion.
  • Specify the inspection probe (for example ACFM) and its integration, calibration and data output.
  • Check access, tether routing and recovery from the work area.

COMPLETE SYSTEM

Specify more than
the vehicle.

The manufacturer designs the A-30 for one-person deployment and lists compatibility with a line-tracking system. The 3 kgf payload is expressed as a force; confirm how it was measured. NDT probes, their certification and the inspection procedure are specified per project.

Confirm in the delivered scope

  • Vehicle and installed payload
  • Control station and software functions
  • Tether length, reel and power supply
  • Selected tools, sensors and deployment equipment
  • Transport cases, spares, manuals and training

Standard, optional and custom items must be listed separately in the quotation.

Browse ROV tools & accessories

QUESTIONS

Before you specify the A-30.

What can the A-30 inspect?

It is designed for wall-contact inspection in small spaces: welds and surfaces in pools and tanks, and inside or outside pipes and structures. The camera gives visual inspection; quantitative NDT needs a suitable probe and procedure.

Has it been used for weld inspection?

The manufacturer reports a development project for a stainless-lined pool, where the A-30 carried an ACFM inspection module and used vision-based weld recognition to follow weld seams automatically. This is a manufacturer reference, not a project delivered by PanPan Marine.
